ask: We need to seriously review this [action/]. I don't like how this is set up right now. What I really want is for this to be a simple, adjustable, and flexible agent. Users should be able to pass a user message to this agent. Optionally they can override the system prompt. Both should ship with good defaults. It should support different providers. It should post the audit results back to GH (if issues found, should open an issue and tag repo owners), and keep artifacts around. Ideally: it should be extendible ... fetch those in my GH workflow, store them in a folder called e.g. 'context', and pass that to the agent as context. I should be able to inject skills flexibly, so that the agent can find and use skills as it needs. Ideally: this would be python-only. This should be separate from kmctl, and just a stand-alone script
